description: Old test identities that passed on a historical baseline and are intentionally absent from the candidate catalog. The comparison accepts an absence only when it is listed here and every successor passed in the same candidate run. A listed identity that still exists in the candidate, or that exists and fails, is never excused.

integration::test_svn_to_git_echo_suppre.reason: The old test expected an SVN revision to be skipped because its log message carried the sync marker. Marker-only suppression was dropped: the same marker-only revision is now applied, and a revision is skipped only when a sync receipt backs it. The two successors assert each half.

reposync-core::sync_engine::tests::test_.reason: The old test asserted that a delete outside the allowed paths passes validation. Validation now reports that delete as out of scope, and an in-scope delete still passes.
The old test only checked that a string contains the sync marker. Marker detection moved to the echo_suppression module, whose test checks the same marker rule through personal_mode_marker_echo.

reposync-daemon::lockfile::tests::test_a.reason: The data-directory lock moved from the daemon's lockfile module to reposync_core::data_dir, and the test moved with it under the same name.

reposync-personal::pr_monitor::tests::te.reason: pr_monitor used to be compiled into both the reposync_personal library and the reposync-personal binary, so this test ran twice. The successor keeps those assertions and adds that ordinary root dotfiles such as .gitignore are now preserved.

team_mode_e2e::candidate_r10_merge_dag_r.reason: Merge DAGs were refused as unsupported_merge_dag. #66 added merge-DAG continuation, so the same pushed merge is now replayed.

team_mode_e2e::candidate_r10_over_1000_p.reason: More than 1000 pending commits were refused. #66 added durable batched continuation, so 1001 pending commits now drain in batches.
